rules.rationale: Base equation defining the allFloatVS structural domain predicate on the empty value sequence.
Constructor recurrence defining allFloatVS by checking the head and recursively checking the tail.
Equation defining the named projection-domain predicate definedProjectFloat as the existing Float sort test.
Trusted simplification fact characterizing definedness of the existing partial Val-to-Float cast; Stage 1 does not first prove this exact statement without the rule.
Identity equation defining the named total projection when its argument is already statically a Float.
Guarded equation defining projectFloatTotal on its intended domain as the existing partial Float cast.
Symbolic reverse orientation of the same guarded equation that defines the named projectFloatTotal proof term in terms of the existing partial cast.
Additional simplification fact extending the existing subtraction dispatch from the static Float subsort to a guarded dynamic Val operand; no rule-free exact proof appears in Stage 1.
Definitional alias naming the supplied minFloat primitive as the fresh opaque proof term minFOpaque.
Definitional alias naming the supplied maxFloat primitive as the fresh opaque proof term maxFOpaque.
Base equation defining the minTailF accumulator summary on an empty remaining sequence.
Guarded structural recurrence defining minTailF for a Float head and a strictly smaller tail.
Off-domain equation completing the total definition of minTailF for a non-Float head.
Base equation defining the maxTailF accumulator summary on an empty remaining sequence.
Guarded structural recurrence defining maxTailF for a Float head and a strictly smaller tail.
Off-domain equation completing the total definition of maxTailF for a non-Float head.
Base equation defining the total minVF summary on the empty sequence.
Guarded constructor equation defining minVF by seeding the minTailF recurrence with the first Float.
Off-domain constructor equation completing the total definition of minVF for a non-Float head.
Base equation defining the total maxVF summary on the empty sequence.
Guarded constructor equation defining maxVF by seeding the maxTailF recurrence with the first Float.
Off-domain constructor equation completing the total definition of maxVF for a non-Float head.
Base equation defining scaleAcc to return its accumulated sequence when no input remains.
Guarded structural recurrence defining scaleAcc for a Float head by appending the named transformed value and consuming one input constructor.
Off-domain structural recurrence completing the total scaleAcc definition for a non-Float head.
Base equation defining lastVal to preserve the current value when the remaining sequence is empty.
Structural recurrence defining lastVal by replacing the current value with the head and consuming the tail.
